name: Herbal Shampoo
subtitle: With 25+ herbs
shortDescription: A gentle, deeply nourishing cleanser crafted with more than 25 herbs.
description: Our signature Herbal Shampoo blends more than 25 time-honoured herbs, led by amla, reetha and shikakai, to cleanse your scalp gently while strengthening roots. It leaves hair soft, shiny and full of life, without stripping its natural oils.
howToUse: Shake well. Apply to wet hair and massage gently into the scalp. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. Use 2–3 times a week for best results.

name: Skin Care Serum
subtitle: Nourish. Hydrate. Glow.
shortDescription: A silky daily serum that nourishes, hydrates and restores your natural glow.
description: Our Skin Care Serum melts into the skin to deliver lasting hydration and nourishment. Light enough for everyday use, it leaves your complexion soft, supple and naturally radiant.
howToUse: Cleanse your face and pat dry. Warm a small amount between your fingertips and press gently onto face and neck. Use morning and night.

name: Handmade Herbal Soap
subtitle: Small-batch botanical bar
shortDescription: A richly textured, hand-poured soap bar packed with herbs for a gentle cleanse.
description: Each bar is hand-poured, pressed with our leaf motif and slowly cured in small batches. The natural herbal texture offers a gentle exfoliation while leaving skin clean, soft and comfortable.
howToUse: Lather between wet hands or on a loofah, massage over damp skin and rinse. Keep the bar dry between uses to make it last longer.
